chapters.title: Learning and Team Experience at Acadon

features.name: Microsoft Dynamics ERP Systems
features.description: Acadon focuses on Microsoft ERP system solutions for various industries. The speaker gained experience in the wood industry and is interested in ERP solutions specifically for that sector.

features.name: Microsoft Thailand Program Membership
features.description: A membership program that allows participants to take courses to become a good Business Central consultant. The speaker obtained this membership through Acadon.

features.name: Business Central Consulting Services
features.description: Services provided to help customers deal with their business problems using Business Central software. The speaker aims to use the software to assist customers in solving issues.
